name: Tennessee Gas Pipeline 300 Line Project
researcher_notes: Not an existing row: P0259 is the whole Tennessee Gas Pipeline system and P5601 (Northeast Energy Direct) and P2496 (261 Upgrade) are different projects. A Federal Register notice from March 2010 for FERC docket CP09-444 lists 127.4 miles of new 30-inch loop in seven segments in Pennsylvania and New Jersey. A Kinder Morgan release from 2011 says the project was placed in service (searched date 1 November 2011). A Pipeline and Gas Journal article from July 2010 reports the FERC approval. Added capacity is reported as 350,000 Dth per day but was not read directly from a verified page, so it is left blank. Cost not staged. Owner spelling per gazetteer; Parent Kinder Morgan not checked against the gazetteer (in 2011 the operator was owned by El Paso, then Kinder Morgan). Start and end locations are not stated; seven loop segments along the 300 Line from Potter County PA to Passaic County NJ. Route not researched: no route.
